mechanism_narrative: High levels of monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) signals a favorable environment for equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High levels of monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (its base year 2017) signals weakening supply conditions that reduce corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 450000) signals robust consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (INDPRO growth rate falling below -0.5% annually), economic uncertainty leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances during supply shocks (INDPRO growth < -0.5% annually), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
